final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(rental_duration) AS ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.rating, s1.ratio, s1.ratio - s2.avg_ratio AS diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.ratio > s2.avg_ratio), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio_above, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM step3) SELECT * FROM step4
